explication: Sellbird is a local-first outreach platform: it discovers businesses, researches buying signals, identifies and verifies decision-makers, drafts and sends approved outreach, then handles replies. The heartbeat coordinates agent work; persistent state supports the dashboard and workflow. The README documents major capabilities beyond the sampled excerpts, so those branches are included with README evidence; several implementation details, especially dashboard and training internals, were not sampled.
